reviews.text: Our Eichler has almost no studs on the living room side, just beams and glass. Anh found a way to mount the TV on a post and the bookcase is strapped into the beam. Clean work.
reviews.name: Minh P.
reviews.service: TV mounting on beam and glass walls

reviews.text: After the last little quake rattled the bookcases, we asked them to anchor everything taller than the kids. Nine pieces, two hours, and they showed us how to release the straps if we move.
reviews.name: Rohan G.

reviews.text: Standing desk with a dual monitor arm. Built, leveled and the cables run through the tray so my cat stopped chewing them. Done before my first meeting.
reviews.name: Eloise C.

reviews.text: The playset kit had more than four hundred parts. Two installers spent a full Saturday in our Willow Glen yard and leveled it on a slope I thought would be a problem.
reviews.name: Bao N.

reviews.text: Rack, bench and a rower in the garage. They checked the slab was level, bolted the rack down and hauled every box away.
reviews.name: Teodoro L.

reviews.text: I am 74 and did not want to climb a ladder for the shelves. They came on a Tuesday, built two bookcases, anchored both and hung the shelves straight. Polite and quick.
reviews.name: Marguerite S.

proof.guarantee: If an anchor or mount we installed works loose within two years, we come back and reset it.
